data.body:
AC AMENDMENTS consolidated (plan-review F1, F2, F3, F4 + gap-analysis F2, F3, F4, F6):

**Plan-review F1 (codebase audit)**: Verify bump-version.sh line 85 branch guard ('Refusing to run on primary checkout') is compatible with running on a feature/session branch. Document in the function header that DSO_MERGE_TO_MAIN_PHASE=version_bump remains vestigial on source-branch execution but is preserved for downstream signal consumers.

**Plan-review F2 + gap-analysis F3 (resume safety)**: REPLACE the 'grep commit body for DSO-Story-Merge:' detection signal. Use INSTEAD: 'git diff --quiet -- "$_VERSION_FILE"' as the idempotency gate (matches existing _phase_version_bump pattern). If the version file is already bumped on the source branch HEAD, skip re-committing. Alternative: dedicated state-file phase entry source_branch_version_bump.

**Plan-review F3 + gap-analysis F2 (push timing + abort on failure)**: After committing the bump on the source branch, push immediately: 'git push origin HEAD'. If push fails (non-fast-forward, hook rejection, network error), the script MUST exit non-zero, log full stderr, mark state.json source_branch_version_bump=failed, and NOT proceed to gh pr merge. Add unit test mocking push failure.

**Plan-review F4 (multi-file no-op detection)**: Post-merge _phase_version_bump no-op detection uses 'git diff --cached --quiet' as the final skip gate (covers package-lock.json + version file together), not version-file-only check.

**Gap-analysis F4 (orphan cleanup retarget)**: _try_reset_stale_version_bump must EITHER (a) be retargeted to scan source branch for stale pre-merge bumps from aborted prior runs, OR (b) explicitly documented as legacy-direct-mode-only with an early-return guard when merge.strategy=pr. Include test.

**Gap-analysis F6 (forward-compat state.json)**: Handle state.json from pre-S5 in-flight PRs gracefully. If state.json shows phase=version_bump (legacy post-merge name) and PR not yet merged, EITHER migrate to phase=source_branch_version_bump and retry pre-merge flow, OR fall through to legacy post-merge bump for that one PR with deprecation log. Add unit test seeding pre-S5 state.json.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] bump-version.sh line 85 guard audited and documented in T2 commit message
  Verify: grep -qE 'bump-version.sh.*line 85|primary checkout|branch guard' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Resume idempotency uses 'git diff --quiet -- \${_VERSION_FILE}' not commit-body grep
  Verify: grep -qE 'git diff --quiet.*version|already.*bump' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Pre-merge push failure aborts pipeline before merge
  Verify: grep -qE 'push.*fail|push.*reject.*exit' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Post-merge no-op uses 'git diff --cached --quiet' final gate
  Verify: grep -q 'git diff --cached --quiet' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] _try_reset_stale_version_bump retargeted OR documented legacy-only
  Verify: grep -qE 'merge.strategy=pr|legacy.*direct.mode|source.branch.*stale' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Pre-S5 state.json migration handled
  Verify: grep -qE 'pre.S5|legacy.*phase.version_bump|state\.json.*migrate' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
